_comment: Accepted risks the security gate will not fail on. Every entry MUST carry a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); scripts/security_gate.py errors if either is missing or the date has passed. This keeps accepted risk auditable and time-boxed rather than a permanent mute.

accepted.reason: Minerva timing attack affects ECDSA signing, key generation, and ECDH; signature verification is explicitly unaffected. This service signs JWTs with HS256 (HMAC), so no ecdsa signing path is ever executed and the vulnerable code is unreachable. The python-ecdsa project treats side-channel attacks as out of scope and ships no fix (fix_versions is empty), so bumping the pin is not an option. Revisit if the JWT algorithm ever changes to an ES* family, or migrate off python-jose to PyJWT.
